Downloaded Spotify for the first time, and I fell in love with it over the course of our holiday. Didn't want to deal with ads ever so I started paying for it when we got home. Never looked back. Went with the Family Plan option for various reasons a few years ago and it's working out great. Just wish they'd stop changing the UX of the

Pay for Premium, its not expensive considering how much music you have access to and all the extra features that become available. If you don't want to pay that's fine. But it's the free service you're getting then and have to live with limited functions.

Oh for sure. I’ve had the premium subscription for 6 years now. I don’t think I can imagine going back to the free version now. The ability to choose your songs, skip songs, and have no ads is a must have for me.
The complaint that users have to pay for Premium in order to listen to whatever they want, whenever they want—that they should get access to all of the music for free.

I’m getting the non premium experience right now and it’s fucking crazy I didn’t even know I had premium until a second ago when I lost it. I get having to pay to download music and listen ad free, but you can’t pick what song you want to play? You can’t skip songs? They charge you for that? I could do that with fucking Youtube! Why would they charge you for that? How is this such a popular way to listen to music? Is there a reason or is it corporate bullshit?

From my experience it’s just that once you go premium and get used to picking your music and not having adds it’s incredibly Annoying to go back. But if you just like listening to playlists for free it’s not that big a deal
They give new users a 14 day sneak peek of premium features. So it's not full premium or a trial but you can do things like choose what to listen to.

I’ve had premium for years, not having to worry about ads, being able to make my own playlists and being able to download playlists for the gym, flights, bad areas with no signal and when the service is down is awesome. I pay $15 a month for family to make sure my kids and husband can have their playlists whenever they need it. This is the only service I’ve kept since 2011.

It is so worth it if for nothing else to remove the ads. You get unlimited skips and free reign of song choice as well. If you know a few people you could also do the family plan and save so much money on premium that it would be stupid not to do it.

I've been a premium subscriber for almost 10 years and I have never once thought to myself "man, I really hate how people are getting Spotify for free" It's weird to care "Unfair to people who are actually paying for premium". No one is forcing you to pay? You can do the 2 weeks free thing if you want.
